author: Nicolai156
body:
Usernames That I Broke Rules On:


Nicolai156   (This Is The Account Where My Rulebreaking started. Also basicly this account is just an alt.)

McFanta   (My Main Account. I Actually Logged Later In Game which resulted a ban evasion punishment.)

Xx_FireWorks_Xx (Formelly Known As Krisdenkule8) (I logged in to this account because at that point I knew What Ban Evading was)

chle_ (He was at my place when I hacked On This Server And He also got caught ban evading but later he got unbanned)


What Rules Did I Break On This Fellow Accounts?

So Let's Start At The Beginning. I was having fun with my friend chle_ and I wanted to troll Avicus which I never should done. I trolled them with installing a hacked client on this account which is my main account McFanta_'s alt. Hacks I Used Was, "Speed And Fly". It was a bad idea. Later I logged In To My Main Account McFanta_ Which Later Got Banned For Ban Evasion which I didn't knew what it was at that point. Later I found about it. Before I found out about ban evasions, I trolled and lied in appeals which I am know getting auto denied appeals which I don't want to happen anymore. Later I made troll appeals on my main account McFanta_. Then I found out what Ban evading was and then I logged in to my brother's account Krisdenkule8 known as today Xx_FireWorks_Xx. And After I logged in to that account that account got also banned for ban evading. Then I kept lying in some appeals on two accounts 1 or 3 times I can't remember that. After a while I stopped trolling. Than I became friends with ocn people that basicly is or were staff members on avicus and then I really wanted to play with them on Avicus. Then I realised I am banned and denied permanently from appeals. Really. Than I really wanted to appeal my bans on these accounts but I kept getting auto denied. Later My brother found out that I got his account banned and that made him sad. And That Made Me realise what i have done to him and avicus. They kept saying on my appeals you have being lying on your appeals which is true and caught ban evading which is also true. Why Am I in this situation on Avicus. I have very close ocn friends such as Javi who is a big role there that I want to play with on Avicus. I just can't still believe what I have done to Avicus. If I never trolled or attacked avicus I would never be banned and I could be a big role here. But that never happend. Thanks to the evil younger me. I hate being At This Situation and I really want To Get Out Of It. I know I will never get unbanned but I still I have A Hope. I know you guys may be thinking he lied in so many appeals he ban evaded so many times, I am sure when he gets unbanned He will do it again. I don't care if you guys think that which you probably are not sure how i will be if I get unbanned On All Of My Accounts. But I do have a hope for getting unbanned on all of my accounts. It's new year and my resulutuion here is to get unbanned on all of my accounts so I can Play On My account become a big role and also let my brother play to! I am sure it wont happen but I do have a hope! I am so sad about my situation. I am too sad :(! Also None Of The punishments or rules I breaked were fake. All horrible things i did were real! I do Not Have any evidence for that.

Why Do I want To Get Unbanned?

For The First I have already explained a lot or too much I guess xD. But I'll explain! I am still so sad for the thing tha happend to me on Avicus 8 months ago. It has almost been a year and I am still sad. I do have my reasons. I really want to meet the awesome Avicus Players I met on my actual accpunt McFanta_ on javi's scrim server not so long ago. Many people are so awesome here and I really want to get good contact with them such as Grape, Javi, Jiveh and Snow all of  them are amazing people and I really need to scrimm with them on Avicus if I ever Get Unbanned which wont happen I guess. It's A new year so I am sure I wont do a thing here again the thing I want to is to get a second chance on all my account especially on my main account McFanta_.  I also really want to get my brother Xx_FireWorks_Xx Known as Krisdenkule8 unbanned here to so I can Play With Him To. He has changed his password so Know I will never be able to ban evade many times which I will never ever do again ! I am so sorry for him that he had to get banned. I can't believe what I have done, lied so many times been rude so many times. Why has this happend :(! I really want to get a second chance. I know It wont happen because no one here trusts me. It's A New year which means new chances right? No i don't think so. But when I ban Evaded I didn't break any rules in game except ban evading though but I broke rules on the forums such as lying on appeals which made me permanently auto denied from appeals. I have been denied so many times but I really need my second chance to make people believe that I can be a great guy and a big role here. This means a lot to me maybe nothing to you but I don't care. I am so sorry for everything , I really want a second chance on all the accounts. I promise to never do such things as this ever again. I am sure you wont believe it but I have a hope for a second chance. I love you all on Avicus so much and I can't believe I have ruined my avicus career for ever :(! I am still a bit sad inside myself. i can't believe I ruined my chance to meet all those amazing people. I am so sad about this situation. I have a good hope for my future on Avicus If I ever get unbanned on all of my account such as my brother's account and my main account McFanta_! I really want this second chance. I have a good hope for this! I am sure you wont trust me but I hope you guys can think about giving me aka McFanta_ and My brother a second chance. I am so sorry about everything last year. I am hoping for a second chance in this new year. i am sure it wont happend but I have the hugest hope! Thanks for reading this appeal. please don't automaticly deny it. Take your time! I love you all! <3


I love you all! <3

Regarding

McFanta_ (My Main Account)

Nicolai156 (My Alt Account)

Xx_FireWorks_Xx (Krisdenkule8) (My brother's account and maybe a bit mine I don't know!)

chle_ (My friend's account but he got unbanned though.)

Thanks for reading <3!

I Love You All <3!

I am looking forward for my second chance and hoping for it!
